purpose: Prevent internal and sibling-domain cannibalization while assigning one primary AIPS URL to each high-value search intent. This is an intent-routing SSOT, not a ranking or traffic guarantee.

current production HTML and canonical behavior
Google Search Console transactional email evidence available in the connected AIPS mailbox
2026-09-03 web SERP sampling for Bangladesh-oriented AI subscription queries
rules: One primary AIPS URL owns one primary transactional intent family.
Do not create near-duplicate pages solely for word-order, price, buy, bKash, Nagad, cheap or Bangladesh query variants.
A product-family hub may own broad plan-comparison intent while an exact plan page owns exact-plan transactional intent.
Provider-restricted informational-only pages must never be promoted as commerce pages without new current evidence and an SSOT change.
Sibling sites must not intentionally clone AIPS transactional money-page copy or metadata for the same primary query.
Price, availability, access model, provider entitlement, delivery, refund, warranty, review and authorization claims remain governed by commercial/provider SSOT, not this file.

Search volume, conversion rate and rank remain unknown until current Search Console and transaction attribution data are available. Priority labels below are qualitative execution priority, not fabricated keyword-volume estimates.

sibling_domain_boundaries.aipremiumshop.com: Primary Bangladesh AI commerce authority: exact product identity, AIPS BDT catalog price, governed access model, buying decision, order path and evidence-backed product guidance.
sibling_domain_boundaries.saveonsub.com: Savings/value/deal and market-comparison territory. Avoid cloning AIPS exact transactional money pages or using duplicate titles/H1/body for the same primary AIPS query.
sibling_domain_boundaries.aiteampremium.com: Maintain its own distinct business/editorial positioning. Avoid duplicate AIPS exact transactional product pages and unsupported shared-access claims.
sibling_domain_boundaries.cross_domain_rule: Cross-link only when it materially helps a user. Do not create a reciprocal keyword network or mass duplicated landing pages to manipulate rankings.
